Package com.rockchip.uhf.sdk

Interface UhfSdkSession

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
FakeUhfSdkSession
public interface UhfSdkSession extends AutoCloseable
SDK-01/03/09: the method surface android.hardware.uhf.UhfSession exposes, reproduced as an interface so UhfSdk can hand out either a real, platform-API-backed session (RealUhfSdkSession) or an offline one with no reader and no @SystemApi access (FakeUhfSdkSession) behind the same type. This interface is the only reason an indirection exists at all — RealUhfSdkSession adds zero logic of its own beyond unwrapping exceptions that don't apply here (SDK-03: "a protocol fix in the platform shall not require an SDK release" — true here because this interface's shape mirrors UhfSession exactly, not because it adds any behavior).

Every method here matches its UhfSession counterpart's name, parameters and thrown exception, verified by direct comparison against the compiled platform class during this SDK's build (see this module's README) rather than left to drift.
